title: Partner Co-sell: Pipeline Review - Tenacity Systems
topics: Next steps for joint demos and enablement
summary: Quarterly partner co-sell pipeline review. Reviewed 5 target accounts, prioritized two for immediate joint outreach (DeltaHealth, MeridianPay). Discussed technical fit, capacity requirements, security asks, and next steps: enablement session, joint deck, and scheduling customer intros. Action items assigned to both Redwood and Tenacity reps.

Schedule technical enablement (SE-led) for Tenacity AEs week of 5/25
Run joint demo with DeltaHealth by 6/2
Set up SOC2/security Q&A with Tenacity and Redwood security by 5/27

transcript:
Header:
Date: 2026-05-12
Start: 14:00 PT
Duration: 48 minutes
Attendees: Jamie Park (Redwood AE), Luis Fernandez (Redwood SE), Priya Malhotra (Redwood Partnerships), Rachel Kim (Tenacity AE), Deepak Rao (Tenacity Director), Samir Patel (Tenacity SE)

Summary (auto): Quick pipeline review, identify top joint targets, confirm owners and next steps.

[00:00] Jamie Park: hey everyone thanks for joining, um great to see you all. agenda is pretty light - pipeline review, prioritize, and then technical gating.
[00:22] Rachel Kim: thanks jamie, excited. we've got a handful of deals where tenacity expects to push redwood in Q2/Q3. want to make sure we align on owners.
[00:35] Deepak Rao: yeah the main ones are DeltaHealth, MeridianPay, and two smaller SIs. DeltaHealth is the priority, they're evaluating hosted vs private.
[00:50] Luis Fernandez: quick q on DeltaHealth - are they looking at dedicated/reserved GPUs or rolling cloud hosted? that will change our co-sell ask and pricing.
[01:05] Samir Patel: they said security first; prefer VPC/private deployment but open if we can show isolation on hosted. they'll ask for SOC2, VPC peering, and KMS.
[01:20] Jamie Park: ok that's helpful. from redwood side we can do private deployment (VPC) or dedicated. latency targets?
[01:35] Rachel Kim: DeltaHealth wants sub-200ms for interactive triage use case - so latency matters. cost is secondary but still important.
[01:50] Luis Fernandez: sub-200ms at scale points to dedicated or colocated region. we'll need to size GPU pool - what qps and concurrency are they expecting?
[02:05] Rachel Kim: initial pilot is small, maybe 20 concurrent sessions, but they expect to ramp quickly if pilot goes well.
[02:18] Deepak Rao: and MeridianPay is more embedding-heavy for fraud detection; they care about throughput and cost - less about latency.
[02:30] Jamie Park: so we have two different plays - DeltaHealth: private/dedicated + security + latency. MeridianPay: hosted + cost-optimized embeddings. good separation.
[02:45] Priya Malhotra: quick ask from partnerships: do we have a joint deck that highlights both deployment options + partner logo for tenacity? partners expect co-branded materials.
[02:58] Jamie Park: yes we do, we'll update the co-branded deck. action: jamie to share updated deck.
[03:10] Rachel Kim: also can we get a short 20-min demo artifact that our AE can use? something trimmed to 15-20 mins that shows latency and security bits.
[03:25] Luis Fernandez: i can produce a 15-min demo script focusing on dedicated latency and VPC connectors - include a brief benchmark slide.
[03:38] Samir Patel: on the technical side, delta's infra team will ask about kv cache persistence and model versioning, how we handle rollouts - are there clear rollback paths?
[03:52] Luis Fernandez: yes we support model rollouts with canary and fallback; we should prepare a diagram. note transcription: "kv cache" sometimes transcribed as "k-v cash" in previous calls.
[04:08] Deepak Rao: security doc request - Tenacity wants SOC2 report and encryption-at-rest details. we will likely get a compliance packet before next stage.
[04:20] Jamie Park: understood, redwood will send SOC2 summary + security FAQ. priya will be copied for partnership context.
[04:32] Rachel Kim: for MeridianPay, we need per-token cost estimates for embeddings at scale. their procurement needs ballpark TCO for a million embeddings per month.
[04:45] Jamie Park: rough numbers: hosted embedding cost approx $0.0004/embedding (placeholder) - we'll send formal pricing. dedicated options can reduce unit cost.
[04:57] Samir Patel: great, can you provide an example cost calc? we can take that to procurement.
[05:08] Jamie Park: yes i'll put together a simple spreadsheet and share.
[05:15] [06:00] Luis Fernandez: technical note - for DeltaHealth's sub-200ms we need to pick a model that fits the use case; smaller LLMs or quantized variants help. also batching strategies matter.
[06:25] Rachel Kim: they'd prefer we avoid quality regression; Delta's clinical reviewers will reject if hallucinations surface.
[06:38] Luis Fernandez: understood. we'll propose model family X (privacy-friendly), show eval results, and include a small prompt engineering playbook.
[06:52] Deepak Rao: what's the expected timeline from pilot to production? DeltaHealth wants a rapid 6-8 week pilot.
[07:05] Jamie Park: feasible: week 1 onboarding + security review, week 2-3 pilot config and demos, week 4-6 pilot run and metrics. need commitment from DeltaHealth champion.
[07:22] Rachel Kim: i'll confirm champion and intro next week.
[07:30] Priya Malhotra: who owns the initial outreach to MeridianPay?
[07:36] Deepak Rao: tenacity will run outreach but would like joint intro from jamie to open the conversation.
[07:44] Jamie Park: i can do that. i'll send a suggested intro template.
[07:50] Luis Fernandez: on integration checklist - Samir, can you share the preferred auth flow with delta (SAML vs OIDC) so we can validate compatibility?
[08:03] Samir Patel: they prefer SAML but flexible. i'll confirm and send details.
[08:12] Rachel Kim: procurement will also request data residency specifics - where does token data live and retention periods?
[08:24] Jamie Park: redwood stores logs in region by default; retention and deletion policies can be adjusted per contract. security team will give specifics in the packet.
[08:36] [09:00] Deepak Rao: any blockers on your side for committing to a joint pursuit?
[09:08] Jamie Park: only thing is we need to get security questions answered for DeltaHealth - SOC2 and KMS integration. once we send docs, we should be fine.
[09:20] Rachel Kim: i think that's the major gating item. otherwise align on the demo dates.
[09:28] Priya Malhotra: can we get a short enablement session for tenacity AEs? 45 min max, focused on playbook and objection handling.
[09:39] Jamie Park: yes let's target week of 5/25. luis to lead.
[09:46] Luis Fernandez: i'll prep a 45-min session: overview, demo, technical FAQ, and handoff playbook.
[09:56] [10:30] Rachel Kim: for sales ops, any partner discounting rules we should be aware of? we need a partner margin to present to our commercial team.
[10:42] Jamie Park: currently we have standard co-sell margin tiers; i'll include a partner pricing appendix with the deck.
[10:51] Samir Patel: technical risk: if delta wants on-prem air-gapped, do you support an on-prem bundle?
[10:59] Luis Fernandez: yes redwood private supports on-prem with a dedicated package; leads to longer procurement cycles but doable. we'll flag the timeline differences in the playbook.
[11:12] Deepak Rao: let's capture that as an action item - Samir to surface if Delta requires on-prem, redwood to provide on-prem statement of work.
[11:23] Jamie Park: noted.
[11:30] [12:00] Priya Malhotra: small ask - can we get customer references in healthcare? DeltaHealth will like to see other health customers.
[12:10] Jamie Park: yes i'll include anonymized reference slides and case studies.
[12:20] Rachel Kim: pricing approvals take time. can we get an early estimate to avoid surprises?
[12:30] Jamie Park: will provide ballpark and label as estimate. procurement will get formal quote once scope defined.
[12:40] [13:00] Luis Fernandez: technical checklist recap: kv cache behavior, model rollout diagram, latency benchmarks (internal), VPC peering steps. i'll draft and share.
[13:14] Samir Patel: perfect.
[13:20] [14:00] Deepak Rao: timing for joint demo with DeltaHealth? prefer week of 6/1.
[14:08] Jamie Park: we can target June 2 or 3. i'll coordinate with delta champion once rachel confirms.
[14:18] Priya Malhotra: anything else on pipeline? any risks on MeridianPay?
[14:25] Rachel Kim: MeridanPay has an internal procurement freeze on 5/20-6/05; that may push timeline.
[14:35] Jamie Park: ok we'll aim to have cost calc and materials ready earlier.
[14:42] [15:00] Action recap: Jamie to share deck and pricing (5/19); Luis to prepare enablement + tech checklist (5/22); Rachel to confirm DeltaHealth champion (5/18); Samir to send auth details and integration checklist (5/20); security sync targeted 5/27.
[15:38] Deepak Rao: thanks all - good alignment. we'll be in touch about intros.
[15:45] Jamie Park: thanks team. end call.
